    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Adapters
    Chooses the implementation of each external port from configuration, so the same build can run against fakes or real sandboxes: harness.sandbox.mode: fake or sbx (agent and transfer) harness.documents.mode: fake or graph (document catalog) The adapter producers are @Startup: an application-scoped bean is otherwise created on first use, which would let a misspelt mode or missing credentials go unnoticed until the first request.
    AgentRepliedEvent
    Raised by a Session when the agent's reply to the running turn is recorded; messageId is that reply.
    AgentReply
    What the agent produced for one turn: its trace, the prose answer, and optionally a financial table.
    AgentTurn
    An immutable snapshot of one turn handed to the sandbox agent: where the session runs, the conversation so far and the new user message.
    ApiError
    The body of every error response.
    ApiExceptionMappers
    Turns application and domain failures into HTTP errors with an ApiError body: 400 bad input, 404 unknown session or folder, 409 a rule says not now (busy, invalid move, stale update), 502 the sandbox or the document source failed.
    AttachUploadCommand
    Asks to store a file the analyst uploaded, so it can be attached to a later message.
    BackgroundRunner
    Runs long work (an agent turn, a session move) off the caller's thread.
    CatalogFile
    A document inside a catalog folder.
    CatalogFileDTO
    A document in a connected folder, with the folder details the attach dialog shows.
    ClaudeStreamParser
    Reads the line-by-line JSON the Claude Code CLI prints with --output-format stream-json --verbose.
    CommandResult
    What a finished command produced.
    CommandRunner
    Runs an external command without a shell.
    ConnectedFolders
    The document folders one analyst has connected, in the order they were connected.
    ConnectedFoldersRepository
    Stores each user's ConnectedFolders.
    ConnectFoldersCommand
    Asks to connect the folders with these ids.
    ConnectFoldersRequest
    Request body for connecting folders.
    CreateSessionCommand
    location is local or cloud; null or blank means local.
    CreateSessionRequest
    Request body for starting a conversation.
    CurrentUserApplicationService
    Describes the signed-in analyst for the sidebar.
    DemoData
    The demo content from the prototype: the OneDrive folder library and five seeded conversations.
    DemoDataSeeder
    Loads the prototype's demo conversations at startup (turn off with harness.seed-demo-data=false), and connects its first three demo folders too, but only when the document catalog is the fake one: a real OneDrive has no such folders.
    DocumentCatalog
    The document source analysts connect folders from (OneDrive in production).
    DocumentSourceException
    The document source (OneDrive) could not be reached or refused the request.
    DomainEvent
    Marker for facts raised by aggregates.
    DomainException
    Base type for rule violations and port failures raised by the domain.
    Dtos
    Translates between domain types and API types.
    FakeDocumentCatalog
    A stand-in for OneDrive that serves the prototype's folder library, so the app runs with no Microsoft account.
    FakeSandboxAgent
    A stand-in for the sandbox agent that answers with the same canned reply as the prototype: it "reads" each attached file, "computes" one calculation, and returns a short summary plus a table when files were attached.
    FakeSandboxTransfer
    A stand-in transfer that reports the two stages the prototype shows ("Packaging context", then the transfer) and waits between them, in either direction.
    FileRef
    A file attached to a message, identified by its name and where it came from.
    FileRefDTO
    A file attached to a message.
    FileSource
    Where an attached file came from.
    Folder
    A document folder in the catalog that an analyst can connect.
    FolderApplicationService
    Orchestrates the document-source use cases: browse the folder library, connect folders, list their files.
    FolderDTO
    A folder in the library.
    FolderId
    Opaque identifier of a document folder in the catalog (an item id when the catalog is OneDrive).
    FoldersResource
    Endpoints for the OneDrive folder library: browse it, connect folders, and list the documents of the connected ones.
    GraphAdapters
    Builds the OneDrive catalog from configuration (harness.graph.*).
    GraphDocumentCatalog
    Reads documents from OneDrive through Microsoft Graph.
    GraphSettings
    Settings for the OneDrive catalog.
    GraphTokenProvider
    Supplies the bearer token for Microsoft Graph: either a configured token used as-is, or one obtained with the OAuth client-credentials flow and reused until a minute before it expires.
    InMemoryConnectedFoldersRepository
    Keeps each user's connected folders in memory, with the same copy-and-version rules as the session store.
    InMemorySessionEventStream
    Delivers session events to the listeners subscribed to that session, on the publishing thread.
    InMemorySessionRepository
    Keeps sessions in memory.
    InMemoryUploadStore
    Keeps uploaded files in memory, keyed by session and file name.
    InvalidMoveException
    The requested move is not allowed, for example moving a session to the location it is already in.
    Location
    Where a session's agent runs: a sandbox on the analyst's machine, or a sandbox in the cloud.
    MeResource
    Endpoint for the signed-in analyst shown in the sidebar.
    Message
    One message in a Session.
    MessageDTO
    A message as the API exposes it.
    MessageId
    Identifies a Message within its Session.
    MessageRole
    Who wrote a Message: the analyst or the agent.
    MoveProgress
    A progress report emitted by a transfer while it moves a session.
    MoveRequest
    Everything a transfer needs to carry a session from one location to the other.
    MoveSessionCommand
    target is local or cloud.
    MoveSessionRequest
    Request body for moving a session; target must differ from where the session runs now.
    MoveStage
    The stages of a move that a SandboxTransfer reports through MoveProgress.
    Pauses
    Sleeping that the fake adapters use to imitate real work.
    ProcessCommandRunner
    Runs commands as operating-system processes.
    RecencyGroup
    How recently a session was active, used to group the conversation history.
    ReplyFormatter
    Turns the agent's Markdown answer into what the UI shows: paragraphs, plus the first Markdown table (if any) as a structured table.
    ResourceNotFoundException
    The session or folder the caller asked for does not exist.
    ResultTable
    A financial table returned by the agent.
    SandboxAgent
    The agent running in a Docker Sandbox.
    SandboxFailureException
    A sandbox port (agent or transfer) could not complete its work.
    SandboxRegistry
    Remembers which sandbox currently backs each session, and the agent's own conversation id inside it so the next turn can resume.
    SandboxRegistry.Handle
    The sandbox a session runs in now.
    SandboxTransfer
    Carries a session's context and files from one location to the other.
    SbxAdapters
    Builds the sbx-backed adapters from configuration (harness.sbx.*).
    SbxCli
    The few sbx commands the harness needs, built as argument lists.
    SbxSandboxAgent
    Runs each turn by driving the agent (the Claude Code CLI) inside a Docker Sandbox through the sbx CLI, locally or in the cloud according to the turn's location.
    SbxSandboxTransfer
    Moves a session with sbx move, which captures the whole sandbox filesystem as an image and starts a new sandbox from it at the destination.
    SbxSettings
    Settings for the sbx adapters.
    SendMessageCommand
    Asks to send a message in a session.
    SendMessageRequest
    Request body for sending a message.
    Session
    A conversation between an analyst and the agent, and the aggregate root for its messages.
    SessionApplicationService
    Orchestrates the session use cases: start a conversation, send a message, attach an upload, and move a session between the local and cloud sandbox.
    SessionBusyException
    The session is running a turn or moving, so it cannot accept the requested operation right now.
    SessionDTO
    A whole conversation.
    SessionEvent
    Something that happened to a session, pushed to clients as it happens.
    SessionEvent.MessageAdded
    A message joined the conversation.
    SessionEvent.MoveCompleted
    The move finished; the session now runs at location.
    SessionEvent.MoveFailed
    The move failed and the session stayed where it was.
    SessionEvent.MoveProgressed
    A move advanced to a new stage (packaging or transferring).
    SessionEvent.StepRecorded
    The agent read a file or ran a calculation.
    SessionEvent.Thinking
    The agent started working on a turn.
    SessionEventStream
    Fans session events out to whoever is listening, such as open browser streams.
    SessionEventStream.Subscription
     
    SessionId
    Identifies a Session.
    SessionMovedEvent
    Raised by a Session when it finishes moving from one Location to the other.
    SessionRepository
    Stores Sessions.
    SessionsResource
    Endpoints for conversations: the history, starting one, opening one, sending a message, uploading a file, moving a session, and following a session live over server-sent events.
    SessionsResource.Ready
    Payload of the first event on every stream.
    SessionStatus
    What a Session is doing right now.
    SessionSummaryDTO
    One row of the conversation history.
    SessionTitle
    A session's display title.
    StaleAggregateException
    An aggregate was changed by someone else between loading it and saving it.
    Step
    One entry in an agent's trace: a file it read or a calculation it ran.
    StepDTO
    One entry of an agent trace.
    StepKind
    The two kinds of Step in an agent's trace: reading a file, or running a calculation.
    TableDTO
    A financial table the agent returned: column headings and rows of cells, one cell per column.
    UploadStore
    Holds files an analyst uploaded from their machine until a sandbox agent needs them.
    UserDTO
    The signed-in analyst as the sidebar shows them: an id, a display name, a role, and the initials for the avatar.
    UserId
    Identifies the analyst.
    VirtualThreadBackgroundRunner
    Runs background work on virtual threads, which suits the blocking calls agent turns and sandbox transfers make.
